description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Kariyawasam Pethangodage Sisira Kumararathne from the Administrative District of Galle and Mr. Kankanamge Siribaddana Chandana Krishantha from the Administrative District of Matara as the Members of the Southern Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a Provincial Council due to members being elected to Parliament. It involves the electoral process, nomination procedures by a recognized political party, and the formal declaration of new members by the Commissioner of Elections. This falls directly under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election-related declarations.
